summary: Appends a node holding a pair of 16-bit values to an owned linked list. Allocates a 4-byte word-pair buffer storing a2/a3, then a 12-byte node that points to it (with a zeroed link and a 1 flag). The node is appended to the list: when the head at this+0x0 is null it becomes both head and tail (this+0x0 and this+0x8), otherwise it is linked after the tail (this+0x4). this+0x4 is always advanced to the new node and the node count at this+0xC is incremented. Returns 1 on success; on first-allocation failure calls FreeWrapper_7bcf(0) and returns 0.

If the pair-buffer allocation returns null, call FreeWrapper_7bcf(0) and return 0 (failure path).
Store the 16-bit parameters into the pair buffer: v4[0] = a2 and v4[1] = a3.
Allocate 12 bytes via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper for the list node.
Initialize the node: node[0] = pair buffer, node[4] = 0, node[8] = 1. When the node allocation fails the node pointer is set to null.
Branch on the list head: if *this (head) is non-null, link the new node after the tail (this[1]+4 = node); otherwise set both the head (this[0]) and tail (this[2]) to the new node.
Advance the tail pointer: this[1] = new node.
Increment the node count at this+0xC.
Return 1 on success, 0 on allocation failure.
